scope: Current official masterbrand imagery for labs, space, formulation, refill and service ceremony; source-only.

method.acquisition: Direct HTTPS downloads from official Le Labo and Estée Lauder Companies pages/CDNs.
method.verification: Local file signature, dimensions and SHA-256; visual inspection of downloaded files.
method.rights_baseline: Research reference only; copyright remains with Le Labo / The Estée Lauder Companies or their licensors. No reuse license inferred.

images.title: Le Labo laboratory-store interior
images.source_page_title: Le Labo – The Estée Lauder Companies Inc.
images.credit: The Estée Lauder Companies / Le Labo
images.rights: Official parent-company asset; research use only; copyrighted.
visual_observations: Wide interior establishes the boutique as a working laboratory rather than a polished salon.
Black steel glazing reveals a back-room work zone while retaining physical separation.
Weathered plaster, white tile, dark timber, worn leather and industrial lamps make age and use visible.
Repeated labeled bottles and kraft drawers turn stock organization into a graphic wall system.
Small LE LABO wall signage is subordinate to the environment and apparatus.

images.title: About-page lab workwall banner
images.rights: Official first-party CDN asset; research use only; copyrighted.
visual_observations: Panoramic composition reads as a catalog of work materials: bundled kraft sleeves, dark bottles, boxes, a candle and tools.
A magnifying task lamp and manual press-like device signal inspection and hand operations.
Rough exposed tile and patched wall surfaces resist pristine luxury finishing.
LE LABO INC. stamps appear on utilitarian pouches and boxes rather than as ornamental signage.
Muted gray, kraft brown, black and warm task light form the environmental palette.

images.title: Fresh formulation / refill pour
images.role: technician action, fresh formulation and personalized object
images.rights: Official first-party CDN asset; research use only; copyrighted.
visual_observations: Tight crop centers two hands pouring clear liquid from a beaker into an AMBRETTE 9 bottle beside a digital scale.
The visible paper label carries scent, formula-style information, formulation date and personalization fields.
Hands, vessel and scale make precision service legible without showing a posed employee portrait.
Window mesh, worn equipment and low natural light keep the action embedded in a working lab.
The image connects refill/formulation, measurement and personalization in one service moment.

images.title: Online refill return — cap bottle
images.source_page_title: Refill Program | FAQ | Le Labo Fragrances
images.rights: Official first-party service illustration; research use only; copyrighted.
visual_observations: Sparse monoline drawing isolates hands securing the bottle cap.
The customer is depicted as an active participant preparing the existing object for return.
Black line on transparency echoes instructional and workshop notation rather than lifestyle illustration.

images.title: Online refill return — place bottle in platform
images.source_page_title: Refill Program | FAQ | Le Labo Fragrances
images.rights: Official first-party service illustration; research use only; copyrighted.
visual_observations: Bottle silhouette is centered inside a hatched cardboard platform while hands guide it into place.
The existing bottle remains the hero object; the package is designed around its safe return.
Hatching communicates humble paperboard material without color or decorative styling.

images.title: Online refill return — review invoice
images.source_page_title: Refill Program | FAQ | Le Labo Fragrances
images.rights: Official first-party service illustration; research use only; copyrighted.
visual_observations: Two hands hold an invoice marked with the Le Labo wordmark.
Paperwork is treated as a visible step in the ceremony, reinforcing record-keeping and traceability.
The restrained line drawing places brand authorship on a functional document.

images.title: Online refill return — place invoice in platform
images.source_page_title: Refill Program | FAQ | Le Labo Fragrances
images.rights: Official first-party service illustration; research use only; copyrighted.
visual_observations: A directional arrow shows the branded invoice entering the same protective platform as the bottle.
The service system binds identity data and physical vessel before shipment.
Hand-drawn instructional style makes an operational action feel deliberately human.

images.title: Online refill return — carrier handoff
images.source_page_title: Refill Program | FAQ | Le Labo Fragrances
images.rights: Official first-party service illustration; research use only; copyrighted.
visual_observations: A hand places the hatched return parcel at a carrier counter.
The final selected frame makes product circulation, rather than disposal, the closure of the customer-side ritual.
Generic carrier architecture keeps attention on the reusable vessel's journey.

cross_image_observations: Space is authored through functional repetition, visible inventory and work zones rather than decorative abundance.
Rough mineral surfaces, blackened steel, dark timber, kraft paper, clear glass and worn leather make material age and touch legible.
Service evidence privileges hands, tools, measurement, documents and existing vessels over smiling retail portraits.
The same laboratory logic scales from architecture to label fields to the refill-return diagram sequence.
Brand signage is typically small and embedded in working surfaces, packaging stamps, labels or documents.

duplicate_check.method: Compared SHA-256 values against all pre-existing files under 01-source-brand/evidence; no exact matches among the eight included assets.

exclusions.reason: Already present as evidence/visuals/EV-LL-004-roots-first-lab.jpg; excluded as existing evidence.
Mobile derivative of the included parent-company hero; excluded to avoid crop duplication.
Refill step 2 is a near-adjacent platform-opening frame; omitted to keep the sequence compact.
Refill step 4 is a near-adjacent bottle-securing frame; omitted in favor of the more legible placement frame.

limitations: The parent-company interior image is official but its precise store location and shoot date are not stated on the page.
The About banner and refill navigation image have no named photographer credit in page markup.
The refill diagrams document the online return path; they do not depict the in-store refill interaction.
Visual observations describe only the downloaded frames and do not claim every global lab uses identical architecture.
